note: Art-directed botanical specimen representations for an illustrative ingredient-to-oil journey; plant part/extraction is not specified by this illustration.

texture.kind: shared photographic 3x3 color atlas and tangent surface normal map

compression.attributes: Adaptive 13–16-bit exponential positions (≤0.00005-unit component error); 12-bit octahedral normals; normalized 16-bit UVs; lossless colors and triangle connectivity
compression.triangleCounting: triangleCount sums every glTF primitive index count; uniqueIndexBufferTriangleCount counts each stored index buffer once. Shared index buffers do not simplify or remove triangles.
